subject: ddl: implement max progress tracking in reorg context (#64917)
summary: Diff adds per-job in-memory max progress tracking (`reorgCtx.maxProgress` + CAS-based `setMaxProgress`) and applies it in `updateBackfillProgress` so the DDL backfill progress gauge won’t regress when `information_schema.*.table_rows` changes during reorg; includes a small unit test and Bazel test target update. No Blocker/High issues found in correctness, concurrency, or DDL state/metadata handling; behavior change is confined to progress metric calculation.
